label: Printers
note: The purchase price of a printer is the least important number about it. Cost per page — cartridge model, yield, and what a replacement costs — decides what the machine actually costs to own, and no listing shows it. That is the whole reason this category is worth recording.

print_tech.label: Technology
print_tech.note: Ink tank is the material distinction in India — refillable bottles instead of cartridges, and roughly a tenth of the running cost.

cartridge_model.label: Cartridge or bottle model
cartridge_model.note: The single most useful fact in this category. It is what you will buy for years, and it is almost never on the product listing.

page_yield.label: Page yield
page_yield.note: Pages per cartridge or bottle, at the ISO standard coverage the maker quotes.

cost_per_page_paise.label: Cost per page (paise)
cost_per_page_paise.note: Derived in the service from the current supply price and page_yield — NOT stored here, because the supply price moves. Declared so the field name is fixed.

discontinued.label: Discontinued
discontinued.note: Matters more here than anywhere else: a printer whose cartridge is out of production is scrap.

sanity.note: A printer record without cartridge_model is a candidate, not an entry. Without it the record cannot answer the only question that matters.
